ihs_outlook.outlook_description: Score affirmation: Small acts of bribery are not uncommon, especially with junior state bureaucrats often frustrating licensing processes.
The central bank has been limiting FX trading and banks have reported difficulties in purchasing USD outside of a narrow exchange rate margin.
Score affirmation: At least two small secessionist movements exist in Angola, but neither have the capability to mount a meaningful challenge.
Recent debt repayment agreements with biggest lenders, especially Chinese banks eases, pressure on government to renegotiate contracts.
Score affirmation: Inefficiency in adjudication of corporate law cases and bureaucratic obstacles frustrate firms' ability to settle disputes.
Lower oil prices, combined with negative real interest rates, intensify pressure on the currency.
Expropriation or nationalisation is unlikely in the next 12 months given renewed efforts to draw investment into agriculture and tourism sectors.
Score affirmation: Reshuffling of the cabinet likely to occur in 2025 as Lourenco attempts to hold off challengers while weighing up a third term.
Tight monetary policy has led to slowdown in inflation in the near-term.
Score affirmation: Electricity infrastructure in particular remains highly inadequate in parts of the country away from the main urban centres.
Score affirmation: Although unlikely, a violent overthrow of the government in DRC would slightly increase the risk of Angola sending troops there.
IMF program is moderately likely in 2025, probably necessitating more subsidy repeals and in turn leading to significant pushback from labour unions.
Regulations aimed at easing operations in tourism and agriculture are likely in the next 12 months as these are identified as key growth sectors.
Risk of protests had decreased, although civil society and youth likely to demonstrate, occasionally calling for municipal elections.
Strong growth in agriculture and mining sectors.
Relaxation of regulations in the tourism and agriculture sectors is very likely to occur in 2025, as these are key growth areas.
Increase in sovereign default risk due to external debt acquisition on non-concessional terms.
Score affirmation: The state's capacity to respond to drought conditions especially in the south-eastern parts of the country remains very poor.
Score affirmation: Consistent application of tax code remains a challenge for those tasked with enforcing it; changes are the norm and confusing.
A rise in corporate tax is less likely especially due to agreements with creditors on debt repayments; attracting investment remains a priority.
While at least two small anti-government groups have intent of secession, they lack the arms and other capabilities required to achieve this.
Score affirmation: GDP per capita is forecast to increase by -0.1%.
